message.content:
Here are the meaningful design differences between the two product cards:

*   **Image Area:**
    *   **Left (Aimch):** Static image. Contains a **"موجود" (In Stock)** badge in the top-right corner.
    *   **Right (Buskool):** Image acts as a **video thumbnail** with a play icon overlay. Has a **"پیشنهاد ویژه" (Special Offer)** banner across the top edge.
*   **Title & Seller Info:**
    *   **Left:** Title is 1-2 lines. Seller name and location are listed as separate text rows below the title.
    *   **Right:** Title is truncated with an ellipsis (...). Seller info is a single row combining name and location, accompanied by a location pin icon.
*   **Stock & Badges:**
    *   **Left:** Displays specific stock quantity (e.g., "10 تن") and a "Verified Seller" smiley-face badge.
    *   **Right:** Shows general availability ("موجود") with a box icon and a blue shield "Verified" badge.
*   **Button (View Price):**
    *   **Left:** Outlined/ghost button style located at the very bottom of the card content area.
    *   **Right:** Solid filled button style located immediately below the seller/stock row (higher up in the layout).
